name: Senior Clipper Card
fullDescription: The Senior Clipper Card provides discounted fares for riders 65 and older on participating Bay Area transit systems.
whatTheyOffer:
- Reduced fares and discounted passes on Bay Area transit agencies
- Discounts vary by agency (for example, 62.5% off BART; reduced single rides and monthly passes on Muni)
- Valid on BART, Muni, AC Transit, Caltrain, and more
- Discounts automatically applied; card can also be added to your phone's mobile wallet
howToGetIt:
1. Apply online at clippercard.com, or by mail, email, or fax
2. Provide an accepted proof-of-age document showing you are 65 or older
3. Or get a card in person at a Clipper Customer Service Center
4. Receive your Senior Clipper card
5. Load cash value or passes and ride with automatic senior discounts
keywords: Senior Clipper, 65+, elderly, senior discount, reduced fare, BART, Muni, AC Transit, Caltrain, Medicare
